name: What are common kitchen layout options?

mainEntity.name: What are common kitchen layout options?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen layout options include the L-shape, U-shape, galley, G-shape, and single-wall kitchen. The L-shape is versatile for small and large spaces, offering an efficient work triangle. U-shaped kitchens provide ample counter space and storage, ideal for larger homes. Galley kitchens are compact and efficient, perfect for narrow spaces. G-shaped layouts add a peninsula for extra counter space. Single-wall kitchens are best for very small homes or open-concept living. The best layout depends on your home's structure and your lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common kitchen layouts include L-shape, U-shape, galley, G-shape, and single-wall, each offering different benefits based on space and functional needs.
